projects.title: Personal Cloud Gaming Orchestrator
projects.summary: A self-hosted cloud gaming platform for one Windows PC: a React dashboard, a FastAPI backend and a Python host layer that supervises Sunshine streaming and Tailscale networking, with watchdogs that recover failures on their own.

page.title: Personal Cloud Gaming Orchestrator: case study | Harsh C Hari

projects.title: Productivity Dashboard
projects.summary: One app for tasks, timetable, study sessions, projects and an AI workspace. Tasks get an urgency score from deadline, effort left and progress, and it installs as a PWA with Web Push alerts that arrive with the app closed.

thumb.alt: Productivity Dashboard task and study view

projects.title: Future of CEC
projects.summary: A Student Portal, admin dashboard and Lift Access system. Google sign-in is restricted to institutional email, students and lift operators get role-based access, and a local Gemma model served through Ollama answers student queries.

thumb.alt: Future of CEC smart campus platform

projects.title: Smart Farming Dashboard
projects.summary: Built in 24 hours: a dashboard that charts simulated soil and weather sensor trends with Chart.js, backed by Firebase, with the Gemini API generating crop-care recommendations.
